reuse.receipt_validation: Validate bound file bytes, original source/config identity, terminal completion, all three passed verdicts and exact initializer kernel digests; not a new scientific qualification gate or 624-forward rerun.
reuse.hash_verification: Initializer files, six R4 inputs, listed receipt files and inherited core source records rehashed as bytes in this preparation. No tensor deserialization.

stream_reuse.integer_encoding: Explicit seed inventories below use base-10 strings to prevent IEEE-754 loss. Parse directly to arbitrary-precision integers and compare to inherited_stream_manifest; never round through float.
stream_reuse.layout_seed_use: One new zero-step layout construction per block as required by inherited backend.prepare; NOT another prototype episode, fresh world claim, reward observation or training record.
stream_reuse.neural_seed_scope: Retain exact original fork sampler/shuffle/bootstrap seeds. Template construction and discarded preflight copies may have initialized or drawn related RNGs previously; do not claim all neural scalar seeds are globally unused. Fresh forks use the original declared starts; no initializer retraining or shuffled demonstrations.
stream_reuse.preflight_sampling: Disposable copies only; never advance live training RNG from preflight or append preflight rows to learner buffers.
stream_reuse.pairing: Same assigned world starts, not guaranteed event-level common randomness after different actions.

audit.method: stdlib JSON/header/ledger inspection and byte hashing; no project imports or checkpoint deserialization

stream_reuse.revalidation_before_admission: Recheck bound receipt hashes and scoped absence of original fork/training/test outputs plus new-root exclusivity before any load or build. Reject any newly discovered consumption; no replacement namespace, seeds or extra audit experiment.
stream_reuse.audit_scope_limit: Unopened in the inspected original S1 and saved-qualification evidence roots; not a new repository-wide or external universal freshness claim.

derivation.new_global_formula: 21300 - (600+900+1800+900) + 300 = 17400; independent new cap, not remaining old clock

runtime_input_binding.time_scope: one aggregate retained section shared by startup, input/runtime binding, all loads, layout builds, initializer restore validation and forks; no separate additive allowance

same_start_preflight.time_scope: one inherited aggregate section, no invented per-block 400-second limit

load_admission.mechanism: Separate durable nonrefundable operation admission ledger, integrated with active phase and same monotonic deadline; debit immediately before each actual historical checkpoint load or environment build
load_admission.envelope_read_policy: Existing retained methods only, evidenced by the existing preflight midpoint paths/restore raw evidence and evaluation sealed header/check receipts under their phase caps. No dedicated extra read counter, repeated audit loop or new gate; no extra allowance or hidden restoration/selection
load_admission.receipt_only_json_reads: Subject to existing phase/global deadlines; not tensor loads

execution_budget.construction_policy: All admitted future model construction must serve restoration of exact three saved initializers or the nine mandatory same-start forks; no alternate initialization, selection, warmup or fit. Temporary constructor RNG is restored/isolated, and full saved initializer identity is checked before forking.
execution_budget.numeric_operation_policy: Debit trajectory, clone, actor and critic calls before execution; durable counters survive failure and cannot be refunded/restored from checkpoints. Zero extra scientific calls in binding, seal, verification, archive or closure.

clocks.origin: outer supervisor before binding, package imports, hashing and numerical child dispatch
clocks.timeout_result: terminal failure; report measured polling/termination/preservation overrun and incomplete evidence, never success or retry

implementation_contract.design: New additive campaign with independent constructor, sequence and budget; preserve unchanged original_config and derive an effective config changing only phase_budgets, totals and recovery metadata for the new accounting/387-row verification. Reuse unchanged inherited core methods for retained work only.
forbidden_reuse: old recovery checkpoint as new budget or sequence
old original 426-episode totals in new verifier
implementation_contract.binding: Validate qualified evidence and file hashes; prepare block layouts/R4 once; admit/load exact initializer once per block; validate full kernel digest and 256 completed initializer actor steps; fork same policy/critic/buffers into own_frozen, own_ppo, own_bc_continue with fresh continuation optimizers and original sampling starts. Persist new binding/fork receipts.
implementation_contract.same_start_preflight: Run all five controllers on one original fork_preflight world per block; clone at t=26 and replay exactly four calls per controller; compare full restored action/reward/patient/RNG state. Compare all three greedy fork distributions and classes at 52 own_frozen contexts per block with zero extra environment calls.
implementation_contract.continuation: All three PPO blocks, then all three BC-CONTINUE blocks; each 32 episodes in eight four-episode rollouts with fixed 4 epochs and 64/64/64/16 batches. Retain final checkpoints only. Frozen arm receives no training trajectories or updates.
implementation_contract.seal: Seal all nine learned artifacts together and check byte seals before each test. A failed/missing block closes the entire attempt; no surviving-block evaluation.
implementation_contract.evaluation: Exactly original five controllers x 12 original test worlds x three blocks, greedy learned classes with original lexicographic tie break, unchanged R4 and full MDL-2. No test fit, stochastic appendix or checkpoint choice.
implementation_contract.verification: Independent saved-data reader verifies 387 new full episodes, 20124 trajectory and 60 clone calls, 768 actor and 384 critic calls, six admitted historical loads, three layout builds and 387 episode builds, source/input/seal identity, raw patient/action/cost records and paired comparisons. Inherited 39 episodes are provenance, never counted as new episodes or pooled with evaluation.
implementation_contract.additive_runner_implemented_by: coordinating parent task; not claimed complete by this proposal

analysis.primary: paired raw total cost own_ppo minus own_frozen
analysis.relative_change: equal mean over three blocks of 100 * block mean paired raw-cost delta / block mean own_frozen raw cost
analysis.screen: relative change <= -1.0 percent and favorable cost direction in all three blocks; patient-adverse directions require trade-off reporting, not overall success
mandatory_reporting: all worlds and blocks, no excluded failures
paired raw cost and patient completions/losses/waiting/terminal-active obligations
raw requested and executed actions, changed-action frequencies and model lineage
per-phase/per-block calls, build/load/read counts, elapsed and inference time
analysis.interpretation: Three training blocks yield descriptive low-precision development evidence only. This restricted graph-aware simulation PPO comparison is not online deployment adaptation, isolated graph attribution, full joint control, PPO-vs-DDPG superiority or clinical noninferiority.

preservation.source_and_input_locks: Preserve exact source, runtime, original scientific config/proposal, this execution proposal, actual approval, input byte manifests, qualified initializer provenance, new raw records, ledger, all model/full state and RNG receipts.
preservation.verification: Per-file SHA256, every archive member and archive byte SHA256; no overwrite of different bytes; retain originals. Seal completed payload before parent supervisor writes later terminal receipts.
preservation.terminal_receipt_archive: A distinct local terminal/launcher closure archive or equivalent verified supplement includes final parent claim/supervisor/terminal receipts and a link to completed payload archive; complete within the 900-second closure and global caps. Never silently omit post-payload receipts or recursively include an archive in itself.
preservation.failure: Preserve available partial weights, optimizer, RNG, collector state, raw logs, ledgers, stdout/stderr and error, under remaining capped closure time. No numerical recovery; report incomplete preservation explicitly.
preservation.restore_permission: Only mandatory in-owner preflight clones in the one running attempt; no restart after interruption, native crash, timeout or terminal failure.

prohibitions: new reward, scenario, cost weight, threshold, actor/PPO/BC setting or comparison
counterfactual/oracle labels or optional clone appendix
early success stop or drop failing block
formal holdout reuse or Stage E reopening
unapproved external action or automatic followon
